# Darmi

> Darmi is a privacy-first iOS food and symptom tracker for people living with IBS
> (irritable bowel syndrome). It turns meals and symptoms into visible patterns and
> into structured data you can bring to a doctor. There is no account, no login and
> no server — everything is stored on the user's own device.

- **Website:** https://darmi.app/
- **Download:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/darmi-ibs-food-symptom-tracker/id6759197247
- **Platform:** iOS
- **Price:** Free to download and use. Optional PRO in-app purchase unlocks unlimited
  data exports (free users get one export per calendar month).
- **App Store rating:** 4.7 stars from 18 ratings (snapshot: 2026-08-02)
- **Contact:** darmi.feedback@gmail.com

## What it does

- **Fast logging.** Quick Picks learn the foods you eat most and surface them as
  one-tap shortcuts. Anything new can be typed in seconds — there is no bloated food
  database to search through.
- **Symptom, stool and stress tracking.** Symptoms, stool type on the Bristol Stool
  Scale, mood and stress are captured in a single flow. Suitable for people tracking
  IBS-C (constipation-predominant), IBS-D (diarrhea-predominant) and IBS-M (mixed).
- **Trigger identification.** IBS symptoms often appear hours or days after the food
  that caused them. Darmi looks backward from each symptom entry and surfaces which
  foods recur in the window before discomfort starts — distinguishing likely triggers
  from genuinely safe foods.
- **Pattern insights.** Symptom trends over 7, 14 and 30-day windows, so you can see
  whether a change you made is actually working.
- **Doctor-ready export.** A structured, chronological history of everything logged,
  exportable and ready to share at an appointment.

## Privacy model

- No account to create, no sign-up, no login.
- No cloud sync and no servers in the current version. Data lives in the device's
  local database (IndexedDB in browsers).
- Works fully offline.
- No advertising SDKs.
- Full policy: https://darmi.app/privacy.html

## Languages

English, Deutsch, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, Français, Español, Português.

## Important limitation

Darmi is a tracking and pattern-analysis app. It is **not** a diagnostic tool or a
medical device, and it is not a substitute for professional medical advice. It does
not diagnose IBS or any other condition — it organizes information so a user and
their healthcare provider can discuss it.
